eps.ov: After emerging from his death-like slumber, Beyond the Grave must defend Mika and Dr. Tokioka from a bloodthirsty hoard of shape-shifting creatures.
eps.oa: بعد أن يخرج «ما وراء القبر» من سباته الشبيه بالموت، عليه أن يدافع عن «ميكا» والدكتور «توكيوكا» أمام جحافل متعطشة للدم من مخلوقات متبدلة الأشكال.

eps.ov: Kenny is abducted by ruthless thugs after stealing a priceless necklace, so Harry rounds up the gang for a rescue mission.
eps.oa: يختطف بلطجية قساة «كيني» بعد أن يسرق قلادة لا تقدر بثمن، فيجمع «هاري» العصابة في مهمة إنقاذ.

eps.ov: Harry and his men return from their mission only to find Joris dead. Later, Mad Dog responds to his brother's pathetic cowardice by going on a killing spree.
eps.oa: يعود «هاري» ورجاله من مهمتهم فيجدون «جوريس» ميتاً. ثم يرد «الكلب المسعور» على جبن أخيه المثير للشفقة بالمضي في موجة قتل.

eps.ov: A somber visit to the graveyard turns ugly when Brandon and Harry make a dangerous enemy. Lucky for them, a powerful mourner is there to bail them out.
eps.oa: تنقلب زيارة حزينة إلى المقبرة حين يكسب «براندون» و«هاري» عدواً خطيراً. ومن حسن حظهما أن أحد المعزّين ذو نفوذ فيتدخل لإنقاذهما.

eps.ov: After joining up with Millennion, Brandon is put to work persuading gamblers to make good on their bets, and Harry becomes the right hand man to a top executive.
eps.oa: بعد الانضمام إلى «ميلينيون»، يُكلَّف «براندون» بإقناع المدينين بسداد ما عليهم، ويصير «هاري» ساعداً أيمن لأحد كبار المسؤولين.

eps.ov: Brandon's visit with Maria raises concern among his new friends. Elsewhere, a rival gang makes plans to crash a Millennion party and take a shot at Big Daddy.
eps.oa: تثير زيارة «براندون» لـ«ماريا» قلق أصدقائه الجدد. وفي مكان آخر تخطط عصابة منافسة لاقتحام حفل لـ«ميلينيون» ومحاولة النيل من «بيغ دادي».

eps.ov: Half a decade after joining Millennion, Brandon has become one of the gang's top sweepers and Harry is more powerful than ever. Their success was hard-earned, and they've got the enemies to prove it.
eps.oa: بعد خمس سنوات من الانضمام إلى «ميلينيون»، صار «براندون» من أمهر منفذي العصابة، وصار «هاري» أقوى من أي وقت مضى. ونجاحهما لم يأت بسهولة، ولهما من الأعداء ما يشهد بذلك.

eps.ov: Brandon and Harry are officially inducted as members of the family, but the party screeches to a halt when a murderous traitor is discovered amongst the guests.
eps.oa: يُضم «براندون» و«هاري» رسمياً إلى «العائلة»، لكن الحفل يتوقف فجأة حين يُكتشف بين الضيوف خائن قاتل.

eps.ov: A ruthless hit man responsible for over three hundred kills is released from prison only to discover that an old friend has been working on a project that will literally raise the dead.
eps.oa: يخرج من السجن قاتل مأجور قاسٍ له أكثر من ثلاثمئة ضحية، ليكتشف أن صديقاً قديماً يعمل على مشروع سيعيد الموتى حرفياً.

eps.ov: Millennion's top executives are being murdered, and Harry is given three days to deal with the problem. Elsewhere, Brandon receives a job offer from a murderous madman.
eps.oa: يُغتال كبار قادة «ميلينيون» واحداً تلو الآخر، ويُمهل «هاري» ثلاثة أيام ليحل المشكلة. وفي مكان آخر يتلقى «براندون» عرض عمل من مجنون قاتل.

eps.ov: Harry strikes a bargain with a traitor, and Brandon puts a bullet in an assassin who doesn't plan on staying dead for very long.
eps.oa: يعقد «هاري» صفقة مع خائن، ويصيب «براندون» قاتلاً مأجوراً برصاصة، لكن القاتل لا ينوي أن يبقى ميتاً طويلاً.

eps.ov: While Brandon takes a long look at his solitary existence, Harry considers life as a married man. Meanwhile, Bunji botches a job, and Bid Daddy finally tells Maria the truth.
eps.oa: بينما يتأمل «براندون» طويلاً حياته المنعزلة، يفكر «هاري» في حياته رجلاً متزوجاً. وفي الأثناء يفسد «بونجي» مهمة، ويخبر «بيغ دادي» «ماريا» أخيراً بالحقيقة.

eps.ov: Big Daddy tricks Brandon into visiting Maria before dropping a bombshell on his number one killer. Harry frames an innocent man to protect his interests in a very secret project.
Harry's true nature is finally revealed when he asks Brandon to do the unthinkable. The sweeper draws on his old friend, but his inability to pull the trigger may lead to his downfall.
Before making his play for control of Millennion, Harry covers his bloody tracks by painting Brandon as an embezzler. Back at the lab, Dr. Tokioka breathes new life into a slain gunslinger.
Big Daddy learns the truth about Harry's underhanded dealings, so he sets out to settle the score with his once-trusted ally. Maria is given the job of protecting Brandon while he "sleeps".
Years after Bid Daddy's murder, Harry orders his men to eliminate a rumored heir to the dead man's kingdom. When Maria is killed in the process, Brandon moves one step closer to his awakening.
Upon his resurrection, Brandon is a given a new name, Beyond the Grave, and a new job: protect Mika from harm as she investigates her mother’s murder.
Grave begins his quest to track down Harry, and Bob volunteers to test out a risky procedure in the hopes of saving his best friend's life.
After escorting Mika on a walk down memory lane, Grave prepares for a showdown with Bunji, who has a few deadly tricks up his sleeve.
Dr. Tokioka risks his life to gather top secret information on the enemy's weaknesses, and Lee goes on a murderous rampage to avenge the death of his friend.
Lee uses Mika as bait to lure Grave within striking distance, and Dr. Tokioka races to the scene of the fight with powerful new ammunition he prepared for the occasion.
Grave and Mika bury their dead friends before the resurrected assassin readies himself for a violent altercation with Bear.
The Millennion board members make an ill-fated attempt on Harry's life, but someone he cares about is mortally wounded in the process. Meanwhile, Grave shows signs of long-overdue decay.
Harry lays his wife to rest before being attacked by those who would see him dead. He's knocked unconscious during his escape attempt, and when he comes to, Grave has him cornered.
At long last, Grave and Harry have come face to face. Will they fight to the death? Or will they join forces for one final run at glory?
